title: Orrery mechanism

intent.caption: Orrery mechanism — A machined gear mechanism with metallic PBR, slow meshing rotation, and a jewel accent pivot.

visualSpec.effects: Primary gear (/prism-mock/orrery/meshes/gear-a.glb) normalized to 1.6-unit diameter, centered at origin in the xy plane; secondary gear instance scaled to 0.9-unit diameter at [1.15, 0.35, -0.1], tooth-meshed at ratio 16:9 (primary 0.08 rad/s, secondary -0.142 rad/s, phase-locked so teeth never intersect). Gear material: machined steel roughness 0.5, metalness 0.55, clearcoat 0.2, clearcoatRoughness 0.3, anisotropy 0.7 oriented radially so spokes catch light as they turn. Jewel pivot: 0.12-unit-radius sphere at the primary hub, MeshPhysicalMaterial color #ff2a38, transmission 0.6, ior 1.76, emissive #ff2a38 intensity 1.8. Arbor shafts: 0.05-radius ink #16161d cylinders through both hubs, z-length 0.8. Contact shadow ellipse 2.6 x 1.2 units at y=-1.2, opacity 0.5. Backdrop plane 7 x 6 at z=-3 with the radial gradient stops; linear fog #0b0b10 near 5 far 11 for depth hint. Time-trigger orbit: camera drifts on radius 0.2 at 0.08 rad/s. Headline baseline at y=-1.7, caption at y=-2.1 on the 0.25-unit rhythm.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Both gears rotate in phase-locked mesh (0.08 and -0.142 rad/s) while the camera drifts on a 0.2-unit orbit; the ruby pivot glints as spokes sweep the key light.

contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 caption (#e8ecf2 on #0b0b10 = 16.9:1); 3:1 large display headline; jewel accent is decorative light, not text
